name: Kawarazaki-ke no Ichizoku
source:
Saitou Rokurou, a college boy working through his summer vacation as a servant of the aristocratic Kawarazaki family, explores a mysterious pavilion on the grounds of the family mansion. 

However things are not as they seem at the Kawarazaki Mansion. Tempted by gorgeous women and "forced" to commit sexual acts, he is dragged into an alternative world of passion and lust. Will he lose himself to temptation or will he escape with something worthwhile?

The answer is up to you to find out...
translation:
大学生斋藤六郎暑假期间在贵族河原崎家担任佣人，并探索了家族宅邸内一座神秘的别馆。

然而，河原崎宅邸的一切并不像表面看起来那样。面对妖艳女子的诱惑，又被“迫使”参与性行为，他逐渐被拖入一个充满激情与欲望的异样世界。他会迷失在诱惑之中，还是带着某种珍贵之物成功逃脱？

答案将由你亲自揭晓…
